name: Cinder Lance
text: A beam of fire pierces every foe in a line and sets them burning
lore: The pyre-keepers lit the chapel's lamps from across the nave with a single thrown flame. The lamps are long cold, but the trick outlived them: held long enough, the flame learns to go through things.

name: Pyre Seal
text: A seal at your feet erupts in a ring of flame and leaves the ground burning
lore: The sextons chalked this seal beneath the pyres so that nothing laid on them would rise half-burnt. It does not ask what stands in its circle. It only waits one heartbeat, and then it answers.

name: Rime Shards
text: Five shards of ice fly in a fan, each one chilling what it strikes
lore: Breath held too long in the ossuary's cold turns to needles. A frost-caller learns to spit them back a fistful at a time, and each one steals a little of the warmth the dead still envy.

name: Glacial Wall
text: A wall of ice stops foes and their shots, but not your bolts, then shatters on those near it
lore: Pilgrims cornered in the lower crypts prayed for a wall between them and the dead. The frost answered a few of them. It never held for long, and it never fell quietly.

name: Arc
text: Lightning strikes the nearest foe and leaps to three more
lore: The first spell a storm-caller learns is how to let the lightning choose. It always finds the nearest thing that breathes, and it is never satisfied with just one.

name: Static Mantle
text: For six seconds, any foe that touches you is shocked and thrown back
lore: Wrap yourself in the storm and it guards you jealously. Whatever reaches for you is struck and flung away; the storm has never liked to share what it holds.
